scenicChapters.title: Madeira ER101 North Coast
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 7.9%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Madeira ER101 North Coast
scenicChapters.narrative: 1007 m come off over 18 km at around 9.1%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

madeira-encumeada-and-paul-da-serra.story: A 63 km one-way ride from near Ribeira Brava, about 1 h 05 of riding. It goes by way of Encumeada Pass and Paul da Serra. The highest point is about 1,000 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
